epigenetics.title: Epigenetics: The Death of the Genetic Theory of Disease Transmission

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000001.claim_text: An 1895 Journal of the American Medical Association report found the average lifespan of doctors was just 55 years.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000001.verbatim:
what he discovered, in an 1895 edition of the Journal of the American
Medical Association was that the average life of doctors was just 55 years.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000002.claim_text: The corrective action is supplementation with plant derived colloidal minerals.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000002.verbatim:
took positive
action to enhance their own lives and the lives of others by supplementing
with plant derived colloidal minerals.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000003.claim_text: Copper deficiency in humans first presents as white, gray, or silver hair.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000003.verbatim:
Copper deficiency in human beings presents itself first as white, gray, or
silver hair.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000004.claim_text: Copper is required to manufacture the heavy elastic fibers in arteries; copper deficiency causes aneurysms.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000004.verbatim:
This has got to be
due to a copper deficiency, because copper is required to manufacture the
heavy elastic fibers found in arteries.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000005.claim_text: Selenium deficiency causes infertility, miscarriages, cystic fibrosis of the pancreas, SIDS, white muscle disease, muscular dystrophy, cardiomyopathy, and more.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000005.verbatim:
Selenium deficiency causes infertility,
miscarriages, cystic fibrosis of the pancreas, Sudden Infant Death
Syndrome in animals, liver cirrhosis, stiff lamb disease, white muscle
disease, muscular dystrophy, anemias, encephalomalacia (Alzheimer’s
disease), cardiomyopathy heart disease, and mulberry heart disease.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000006.claim_text: An early sign of selenium deficiency in older adults is the appearance of liver spots or age spots.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000006.verbatim:
Another early symptom of selenium deficiency in older humans is the
appearance of “liver spots” or “age spots.”

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000007.claim_text: Selenium supplementation prevented, and in many cases reversed or cured, selenium-deficiency diseases in animals.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000007.verbatim:
In each
case, selenium supplementation prevented the disease and in many cases
reversed or cured existing diseases, which were all significant causes of
animal losses to the livestock industry.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000008.claim_text: Zoo marmosets and shrews died of diabetes attributed to chromium and vanadium deficiency (observed at autopsy).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000008.verbatim:
I saw marmosets, alligators, and
shrews that died of diabetes, a chromium and vanadium deficiency.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000009.claim_text: Calcium deficiency alone can result in as many as 147 different diseases (osteoporosis, osteoarthritis, Bell's palsy, tinnitus, trigeminal neuralgia, spinal stenosis, and more).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000009.verbatim:
Calcium deficiency alone could result in as many as 147 different diseases
ranging from osteoporosis, osteoarthritis, osteomalacia, degenerative
athritis, Bell’s Palsy, tinnitis, trigeminal neuralgia, and spinal stenosis to
name a few.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000010.claim_text: In the clinical phase of trace-mineral deficiency, full-blown disease states appear: cardiomyopathy, diabetes, cancer, liver cirrhosis.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000010.verbatim:
The clinical phase of trace mineral deficiencies is characterized by the onset
of full-blown disease states and even death—i.e., cardiomyopathy, diabetes,
cancer, liver cirrhosis.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000011.claim_text: The recommended maintenance dose for germanium is 20–30 mg per day (50–100 mg/day is used for serious illness requiring increased oxygenation).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000011.verbatim:
Twenty to 30 mg per day is the recommended maintenance dose for
germanium. Fifty to 100 mg per day doses are commonly used when an
individual has a serious illness that requires an increased oxygen level in
the body.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000012.claim_text: Germanium deficiency is typified by reduced immune status, arthritis, osteoporosis, low energy, and cancer.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000012.verbatim:
A severely reduced immune status, arthritis, osteoporosis, low energy, and
cancer typify deficiencies of germanium.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000013.claim_text: Humans can consume 400 mg of silver per day; silver deficiency results in an impaired immune system.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000013.verbatim:
Humans can
consume 400 mg of silver per day. A silver “deficiency” results in an
impaired immune system.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000014.claim_text: Silver is antibacterial, antiviral, and antifungal, disabling enzymes that microorganisms use for respiration.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000014.verbatim:
Silver is an anti-bacterial, anti-viral, anti-fungal, anti-metabolite that
disables specific enzymes that microorganisms use for respiration.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000015.claim_text: Per USDA researcher Richard Anderson, 90 percent of Americans are deficient in chromium.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000015.verbatim:
According to Richard Anderson, USDA, “Ninety percent of
all Americans are deficient in chromium.”

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000016.claim_text: Chromium supplementation increased laboratory-animal lifespan by 33.3 percent (Gary Evans, Bemidji State University).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000016.verbatim:
Gary Evans, Bemidji State University, Minnesota, very clearly showed an
increased life span in laboratory animals by 33.3 percent when they were
supplemented with chromium.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000017.claim_text: Chromium deficiency produces a wide range of clinical diseases (low blood sugar, type II diabetes, elevated triglycerides/cholesterol, coronary vessel disease, infertility) and a shortened lifespan, aggravated by concurrent vanadium deficiency.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000017.verbatim:
Deficiencies of chromium in humans are
characterized by a wide variety of clinical diseases as well as a shortened
life expectancy. The clinical diseases of chromium deficiency are
aggravated by concurrent vanadium deficiencies.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000018.claim_text: Cesium chloride is used in alternative cancer therapy ('high-pH therapy'), entering the cancer cell to produce an alkaline environment.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000018.verbatim:
Cesium chloride is used as part of alternative cancer therapy programs.
Cesium provides “high ph therapy” for cancer by entering the cancer cell
and producing an alkaline environment.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000019.claim_text: Pica (a compulsion to eat ice, dirt, or lead paint) is a specific sign of iron deficiency.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000019.verbatim:
Experimental evidence shows very clearly that “pica” is a specific sign of
iron deficiency. Pica can drive children and adults to eat ice (pagophagia),
dirt (geophagia), or lead paint.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000020.claim_text: Iron deficiency symptoms include fatigue, heart palpitations on exertion, reduced cognition and memory, sore tongue, and hypochromic microcytic anemia.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000020.verbatim:
Symptoms of iron deficiency
include listlessness, fatigue, heart palpitations on exertion, reduced
cognition, memory deficits, sore tongue, angular stomatitis dysphagia, and
hypochromic microcytic anemia.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000021.claim_text: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) increases iron absorption; clays and phytates decrease it.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000021.verbatim:
Ascorbic acid increases the absorption of iron;
clays and phytates decrease the absorption of iron.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000022.claim_text: Excess iron can cause liver cirrhosis, pancreatic fibrosis, diabetes, and heart failure (largely by raising the need for selenium, copper, and zinc).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000022.verbatim:
Excesses of iron can cause cirrhosis of the liver, fibrosis of the pancreas,
diabetes, and heart failure.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000023.claim_text: Iodine combines with the amino acid tyrosine to manufacture the thyroid hormone thyroxin.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000023.verbatim:
In combination with the amino acid tyrosine,
iodine is manufactured into the thyroid hormone thyroxin.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000024.claim_text: Since Americans began restricting salt intake on doctors' advice, goiter and hypothyroidism have become epidemic (iodized salt was a key iodine source).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000024.verbatim:
Iodine intake is
usually low to begin with, but since Americans have begun restricting their
salt intake at the advice of their doctors, goiter and hypothyroidism has
become epidemic.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000025.claim_text: Copper is a required cofactor to utilize iodine; copper deficiency can drive an iodine-deficiency (goiter) state even where soil iodine is adequate.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000025.verbatim:
A severe copper deficiency
in the soils of the north and the south cause the deficiency state because
copper is a required cofactor to utilize iodine.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000026.claim_text: Manganese deficiency causes birth defects (congenital ataxia, deafness), asthma, convulsions, skeletal defects, and joint problems including TMJ, repetitive motion syndrome, and carpal tunnel syndrome.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000026.verbatim:
Deficiency diseases of Mn are very striking, ranging from severe birth
defects (congenital ataxia, deafness, chondrodystrophy), asthma,
convulsions, retarded growth, skeletal defects, disruption of fat and
carbohydrate metabolism to joint problems in children and adults (i.e. TMJ,
Repetitive Motion Syndrome, Carpal Tunnel Syndrome).

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000027.claim_text: Manganese is structural to the three small ear bones and to joint cartilage.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000027.verbatim:
Manganese is part of the developmental process and the structure
of the three fragile ear bones and joint cartilage.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000028.claim_text: Molybdenum is an integral part of three essential enzymes: xanthine oxidase, aldehyde oxidase, and sulfite oxidase.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000028.verbatim:
Molybdenum is known to be an integral part of no less
than three essential enzymes: Xanthine oxidase, Aldehyde oxidase, and
Sulfite oxidase.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000029.claim_text: Selenium is the most efficient antioxidant, working in the glutathione peroxidase enzyme system to keep body fats from going rancid.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000029.verbatim:
Selenium is the most efficient antioxidant (anti-peroxident).
It’s used at the subcellular level in the glutathione peroxidase enzyme
system and metalloamino acids (selenomethionine, etc.).

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000030.claim_text: High vegetable-oil intake combined with selenium deficiency is, per Wallach, the quickest route to heart attack and cancer.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000030.verbatim:
High intakes of vegetable oils,
including salad dressing and cooking oils, concurrent with a selenium
deficiency is the quickest route to a heart attack and cancer.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000031.claim_text: Tin deficiency in rats produced poor growth, hearing loss, and bilateral (male-pattern) hair loss; Wallach links tin to male-pattern baldness and hearing loss.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000031.verbatim:
Rats fed tin at 17.0 ng/gm show poor growth, reduced feeding efficiency,
hearing loss, and bilateral (male pattern) hair loss, while rats fed 1.99
|ng/gm were physiologically and anatomically normal.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000032.claim_text: Strontium deficiency is associated with certain calcium- and boron-resistant forms of osteoporosis and arthritis.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000032.verbatim:
Deficiencies of strontium are associated with certain types of Ca and boron
resistant osteoporosis and arthritis.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000033.claim_text: Strontium can substitute for calcium in many organisms, including humans, and concentrates in bone.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000033.verbatim:
where it’s most highly concentrated in mammalian bone. Strontium
can replace calcium in many organisms, including man.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000034.claim_text: Vanadium functions like insulin, making cell-membrane insulin receptors more sensitive and aiding glucose/carbohydrate intolerance.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000034.verbatim:
Vanadium appears to function
like insulin by altering cell membrane function for ion transport.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000035.claim_text: Vanadium supplementation can reduce or even eliminate most cases of adult-onset diabetes.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000035.verbatim:
Vanadium supplementation can have a major positive
economic impact by reducing or even eliminating most cases of adult onset
diabetes.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000036.claim_text: Vanadium has anticarcinogenic properties; in mice it blocked induction of mammary tumor growth and reduced tumor incidence.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000036.verbatim:
Vanadium has known
anticarcinogenic properties. Feeding 25 |ng of vanadium per gram of diet
blocked induction of mouse mammary tumor growth.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000037.claim_text: At least 70 metalloenzymes require zinc as a functional cofactor.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000037.verbatim:
There are no less than 70 metalloenzymes that require Zn as a
functional cofactor.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000038.claim_text: Zinc is integral to the RNA molecule (the 'metallic fingers') and participates in cell division and DNA synthesis.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000038.verbatim:
Zinc is also an integral part of the RNA molecule itself where Zinc
provides the “metallic fingers” and participates in cell division and
synthesis of DNA.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000039.claim_text: Zinc deficiency produces a wide range of diseases, including congenital birth defects and degenerative diseases across all age groups.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000039.verbatim:
Zinc deficiency
produces a wide range of diseases including congenital birth defects and
degenerative diseases of all age groups.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000040.claim_text: Excess dietary copper and iron, and high-phytate (vegan) diets, reduce the availability of dietary zinc.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000040.verbatim:
Excesses of dietary copper and iron and high phytate diets (vegans) will
reduce availability of dietary zinc.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000041.claim_text: Vitamin A deficiency in children causes keratitis, corneal ulcers, and blindness.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000041.verbatim:
Vitamin A deficiencies in
children caused keratitis, corneal ulcers, and blindness.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000042.claim_text: Folic acid (or zinc) deficiency causes spina bifida and serious cleft palate in infants.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000042.verbatim:
Infants born with spina bifida and serious cleft palates as a result of folic
acid or zinc deficiencies did not survive the primitive environment.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000043.claim_text: Thiamin (vitamin B1) deficiency causes beriberi with resulting congestive heart failure.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000043.verbatim:
Beriberi with resultant congestive
heart failure was common, the result of a thiamin or vitamin Bl deficiency.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000044.claim_text: Vitamin B12 is a water-soluble red crystalline substance; its red color comes from the cobalt atom at its center.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000044.verbatim:
Vitamin B12 is a red crystalline substance that is water soluble. The red
color is due to the cobalt in the molecule.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000045.claim_text: About 30 percent of vitamin B12 activity is lost during cooking (electric, gas, or microwave).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000045.verbatim:
About 30 percent of B12 activity is lost during cooking
(electric, gas, or microwave).

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000046.claim_text: Supplemental chromium prevents and treats both diabetes and hypoglycemia (known since 1958).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000046.verbatim:
Since
1958, it has been known that supplemental chromium will prevent and treat
diabetes as well as hypoglycemia.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000047.claim_text: A University of Vancouver medical school statement (1985): vanadium will replace insulin for adult-onset diabetics.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000047.verbatim:
the medical school at the
University of Vancouver, BC, Canada stated that “vanadium will replace
insulin for adult onset diabetics.”

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000048.claim_text: Diabetes treatment starts with chromium and vanadium at 250 mcg/day in the initial stages to prevent insulin shock.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000048.verbatim:
Treatment of diabetes should include chromium and vanadium at 250
meg/day in the initial stages to prevent “insulin shock”

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000049.claim_text: The diabetes regimen also includes zinc 50 mg t.i.d., B-complex 50 mg t.i.d. (with niacin), EFAs 5 g t.i.d., B12 1,000 mcg/day, quercetin 150 mg/day, copper 2-3 mg/day, lecithin 2,500 mg t.i.d., and glutathione 100 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000049.verbatim:
Treatment of diabetes should also include zinc at 50 mg t.i.d., B-complex at
50 mg t.i.d. (be sure to include niacin which is part of the GTF “glucose
tolerance factor”), essential fatty acids at 5 gm t.i.d., B12 at 1,000 meg/day,
bioflavonoids including quercetin at 150 mg/day, copper at 2-3 mg/day,
lecithin at 2,500 mg t.i.d., and glutathione at 100 mg/day.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000050.claim_text: Osteoarthritis and degenerative arthritis are a complex of nutritional deficiencies; rheumatoid arthritis's overt cause is chronic Mycoplasma infection.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000050.verbatim:
osteoarthritis and degenerative arthritis are a complex of
nutritional deficiencies. In the case of rheumatoid arthritis, a chronic
infection with a Mycoplasma spp. is the overt cause.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000051.claim_text: Arthritis treatment includes calcium at 2,000 mg/day (more if eating meat) plus magnesium at 800-1,000 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000051.verbatim:
Treatment of arthritis should include calcium at 2000 mg/day and more if
you eat meat two or three times per day. Also take magnesium at 800-1000
mg/day

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000052.claim_text: A dietary calcium:phosphorus ratio of 2:1 is ideal but impossible to attain on an unsupplemented diet; the more meat eaten, the more calcium supplementation needed.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000052.verbatim:
A dietary calcium/phosphorus ratio of 2:1 is ideal yet impossible to attain in
an unsupplemented diet.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000053.claim_text: Asthma is a malabsorption disease featuring essential fatty acid, manganese, and magnesium deficiencies.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000053.verbatim:
Asthma is a
disease of malabsorption with essential fatty acid deficiencies and
deficiencies of manganese and magnesium.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000054.claim_text: Cor pulmonale treatment includes resolving the lung disease plus oxygen, IV hydrogen peroxide, and selenium at 500-1,000 mcg/day for adults.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000054.verbatim:
Treatment of cor pulmonale includes resolving the precipitating lung
disease and oxygen, IV hydrogen peroxide, and selenium at 500-1,000 meg
per day for adults.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000055.claim_text: Cradle cap treatment includes regular shampooing plus B6 at 10-25 mg/day and zinc at 15-25 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000055.verbatim:
Treatment of cradle cap includes shampooing regularly to loosen the greasy
scale, B6 at 10-25 mg per day, and zinc at 15-25 mg per day.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000056.claim_text: Cancer prevention includes beta-carotene at ~300,000 IU/day (vitamin A equivalent) and selenium at 250-500 mcg/day, alongside a low-fat, high-fiber, fried-food-free diet.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000056.verbatim:
Try to OD on beta-carotene
(almost impossible—first sign is dry skin) at about a vitamin A equivalent
of 300,000 IU per day. Use selenium at 250 to 500 meg per day.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000057.claim_text: Per the US government, the five-year cancer survival rate has not changed in 20 years despite new surgery/radiation/chemotherapy — untreated patients as a group survived longer.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000057.verbatim:
CHEMOTHERAPY—IN FACT, UNTREATED
PATIENTS, AS A GROUP, SURVIVED LONGER!

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000058.claim_text: Osteoporosis is easy to prevent and cure with proper supplementation of stomach acid (HCl) and calcium.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000058.verbatim:
In our personal experience
osteoporosis is easy to prevent and cure with proper supplementation of
stomach acid (HC1) and calcium.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000059.claim_text: Estrogen and fluoride supplementation alone do not solve osteoporosis.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000059.verbatim:
The big push by the “orthodox”
doctors is for estrogen and fluoride supplementation, yet these two
compounds alone do not solve the problem.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000060.claim_text: Osteoporosis treatment includes betaine HCl and pancreatic enzymes (75-200 mg t.i.d. before meals) plus calcium and magnesium at 2,000 and 1,000 mg/day or more for the first 30 days.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000060.verbatim:
Treatment of osteoporosis should include betaine HC1 and pancreatic
enzymes at 75-200 mg t.i.d. 15 minutes before meals, and calcium and
magnesium at 2,000 mg and 1,000 mg per day or more for the first 30 days.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000061.claim_text: Estrogen may be contraindicated for osteoporosis due to a potential carcinogenic effect — it is known to cause breast and uterine cancer.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000061.verbatim:
Estrogen may be contraindicated because of the potential carcinogenic
effect: it is known to cause breast and uterine cancer.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000062.claim_text: Per Wallach, 95 percent of all otitis (earaches) is the result of a milk allergy.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000062.verbatim: In reality, 95 percent of all otitis (earaches) is the result of a milk allergy.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000063.claim_text: The essential fatty acids are linoleic, linolenic, and arachidonic acids; about 3% of total daily calorie intake should come from EFAs (linoleic and linolenic are strictly essential).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000063.verbatim:
Three polyunsaturated fatty acids (linoleic, linolenic, and arachidonic acids)
are known as essential fatty acids (EFA). Three percent of the total daily
calorie intake is required from EFA.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000064.claim_text: EFAs are the raw material the body uses to manufacture prostaglandins, which regulate blood pressure, heart rate, vascular and bronchial dilation, blood clotting, and CNS function.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000064.verbatim:
EFA’s are also the raw material for the human body to
manufacture prostaglandins that help regulate blood pressure, heart rate,
vascular dilation, blood clotting, bronchial dilation, and central nervous
system (brain and spinal cord) function.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000065.claim_text: Essential fatty acid deficiency in infants causes poor growth, eczema, and lowered resistance to infectious disease.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000065.verbatim:
EFA deficiency in human infants
results in a poor growth rate, eczema, and lowered resistance to infectious
diseases.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000066.claim_text: Wallach adds arginine, taurine, and tyrosine to the classic essential amino acids — over the long haul preventing cancer, macular degeneration, and goiter respectively.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000066.verbatim:
To the classic list of essential amino
acids, I would add arginine, taurine, and tyrosine. Over the long haul, these
three amino acids help prevent certain specific diseases. Respectively, those
diseases are cancer, macular degeneration, and goiter.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000067.claim_text: Tryptophan is a precursor of niacin and serotonin; phenylalanine of thyroxin and epinephrine; methionine forms choline and creatine phosphate.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000067.verbatim:
Tryptophane precursor of niacin and serotonin
Phenylalanine precursor of thyroxin and epinephrine
Methionine formation of choline and creatine phosphate

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000068.claim_text: Cholesterol is structural to cell walls and myelin and is the raw material for vitamin D, bile acids, and the steroid hormones (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone).
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000068.verbatim:
Cholesterol is an essential part
of the structure of cell walls, brain and spinal cord (myelin), the raw
material for the production of vitamin D in the human body, bile acids,
adrenal cortical hormones, estrogen (a cholesterol deficiency makes
menopause a living hell), progesterone, and testosterone

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000069.claim_text: Infertility is usually caused by a nutritional deficiency; Wallach reports curing several hundred cases with supplementation of vitamins, minerals, trace minerals, and digestive aids.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000069.verbatim:
INFERTILITY (curable inability to have children) is usually caused by a
nutritional deficiency of some nutrient. We have “cured” several hundred
cases of infertility by simple supplementation of vitamins, minerals, trace
minerals, and digestive aids.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000070.claim_text: Infertility protocol: EFA 5 g t.i.d., L-arginine 500 mg t.i.d., zinc, selenium 250 mcg/day, vitamin A 100,000 IU/day for 30 days then 25,000 IU/day, and germanium 50 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000070.verbatim:
EFA at 5 gm t.i.d., 1-arginine at 500 mg t.i.d., zinc at 15 gm t.i.d., selenium
at 250 meg/day, vitamin A at 100,000 IU/day for 30 days then drop to
25,000 IU/day, germanium at 50 mg/day

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000071.claim_text: Selenium prevents muscular dystrophy in all its forms (and Keshan disease, heart muscular dystrophy); preconception selenium levels matter for both pregnancy maintenance and MD prevention.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000071.verbatim:
The selenium levels in
preconception women is important to the maintenance of pregnancy as well
as the prevention of muscular dystrophy in all of its forms

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000072.claim_text: Given selenium and vitamin E (IM or IV) at the very first onset of symptoms, muscular dystrophy can be arrested or even cured.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000072.verbatim:
If selenium and vitamin E were to
be given IM or IV at the very first onset of symptoms, the disease will be
arrested or maybe even “cured.”

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000073.claim_text: MD / Keshan disease treatment uses selenium (oral colloidal, IV or IM) at 50-1,000 mcg/day by weight plus vitamin E IM at 80 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000073.verbatim:
Treatment of MD and/or Keshan disease includes the use of selenium orally
(plant derived colloidal minerals), IV or IM at 50-1,000 meg per day (based
on weight), vitamin E IM at 80 mg per day

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000074.claim_text: Muscle cramps (charley horse) are a mini-convulsion in the muscle resulting from deficiencies of calcium and magnesium.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000074.verbatim:
MUSCLE CRAMPS (Charley horse) are a “mini” convulsion that is taking
place in the muscle as a result of deficiencies of calcium, magnesium

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000075.claim_text: Insomnia treatment includes avoiding caffeine and food allergens, calcium (esp. plant-derived colloidal), and chromium + vanadium at 25-200 mcg t.i.d.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000075.verbatim:
Treatment for insomnia includes avoidance of caffeine and offending food allergens, calcium
(especially plant derived colloidal calcium), chromium and vanadium at 25-200 meg t.i.d.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000076.claim_text: For angina, calcium 2,000 mg/day, magnesium 800 mg/day, and essential fatty acids help prevent disease progression; lifestyle change and supplementation can reverse cardiovascular disease.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000076.verbatim:
Calcium (2000 mg/day) and magnesium (800 mg/day) and essential fatty
acids can help prevent progress of current disease

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000077.claim_text: Chronic loss of the sense of smell (anosmia) is most frequently the result of a zinc deficiency.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000077.verbatim:
Chronic loss of the sense of
smell is most frequently the result of a zinc deficiency.

WAL-CLM-DDDL-000078.claim_text: Anxiety/panic treatment: avoid caffeine and sugar; chromium + vanadium 200-300 mcg/day, B6 100 mg t.i.d., B3 450 mg t.i.d., L-tryptophan, calcium 2,000 mg/day, magnesium 800 mg/day.
WAL-CLM-DDDL-000078.verbatim:
Take chromium and vanadium
200-300 meg/day, B6 100 mg t.i.d., B3 450 mg t.i.d. as time-release tablets,
Bl, B2, and B5 at the rate of 50 mg t.i.d., L-tryptophan 10 grams t.i.d.,
calcium 2000 mg/day, and magnesium at 800 mg/day.
